name: 日付範囲と請求項目を示すBilling History表
prompt: Recompose the exact billing-history UI into a very shallow panoramic 1137:204 composition. Tighten vertical spacing and remove blank canvas while keeping the full title, date-range control, four column headers, and displayed row visible. Preserve all copy and data exactly; leave 請求額 and 状態 blank. Maintain white surfaces, slate-neutral controls, and the official Lighthouse gradient only on the small title marker. No tint colors, washes, or glow. Do not add content. After generation, preserve the full image and make a crop-only export to remove excess empty canvas without scaling or repainting.
reviewNotes: Reviewed v2. Full-canvas ImageGen output is preserved in the work record; registered export crops only excess blank canvas at x=0,y=150,w=2095,h=405 with no scaling or repainting. Official gradient appears only in the title marker; surfaces stay white and controls slate-neutral with no tint. Original date, item, and statement number are retained; charge and status cells remain blank. Visual review is of the static image only. Retrospective correction: the registered v2 crop trimmed the source row lower divider; v3 corrects the crop and includes the full rule.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
